description: CommandMate #3002 (+ Kewton/commandmate-skills#273): an issue WITH a deliverable heading has declared its scope, so a path it writes anywhere else — `## やること`, `## 完了条件`, `## 追記 N`, with or without a `/` (`app.spec.yaml`) — is a mention, not a declaration. Measured on Kewton/Musunest: "the diff of package.json is zero" (#181) and "stop if ci.yml needs a change" (#183) GRANTED write permission on the file they forbade; a bare `app.spec.yaml` (#211) became an undeclared scope entry; and a short sample spelling in an addendum (#180) raised `ambiguous_file_candidate` for two days. All of them now go to `reference_files` and ONE `prose_path_ignored` notice per issue names them (a harness path is left out: #177 already denies it silently by design). Three more halves are pinned here: `### 既存ファイル` / `### 新規ファイル` do NOT close `## 対象ファイル` (#273 — the document under a subsection stays a deliverable), and `## 変更対象外` is NOT a deliverable heading even though it contains 変更対象 (its file stays out of scope, and since Issue #301 is also carried to `scope_deny`). Issue #301 以降、warning（notice を含む）が1件でもある plan の status は `partial` である。
